static_traits.name: 李成
static_traits.family_status: 父亲在其2岁时去世；其余Not mentioned
static_traits.social_status: 有几位一起钓鱼的朋友，近期注意到其在钓鱼行程中的挫败与缺乏享受；但李成not yet与他们深入分享具体困扰
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往心理治疗经历；not yet有类似心理问题史
static_traits.language_features: 思路清晰、表达具体，能回顾时间线与情境；合作度较高，情绪基调为挫败与Self-doubt；能进行自我Reflection，并愿意尝试小步骤的改变

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直相信自己怎么都钓not到鱼，尽管我很喜欢钓鱼。这种信念让我感到挫败和Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent feelings of failure and frustration have markedly affected my enjoyment of life, so I have come to seek counseling; I want to improve this situation.
growth_experiences: 2岁时父亲去世，成长过程中缺乏父亲角色的陪伴与指导（其余家庭细节Not mentioned）。

special_situations.event: 每次外出钓鱼后都空手而归
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only catching a fish counts as success; otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles down on changing bait and techniques, asks experienced fishing friends for advice to prove one can do it

special_situations.event: During fishing, there are also moments of enjoying nature and the process
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有结果（钓到鱼）才有价值，过程中的愉悦not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores positive experiences in the process, putting all attention on whether a fish is caught

special_situations.event: 与钓友一起出行或谈论钓鱼表现时，朋友注意到他越来越not开心
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果让do not人知道我钓not到鱼，他们会看低我/觉得我小题大做
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing deep sharing with friends, avoiding talking about one's own frustration
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我在夸大或笑话我

special_situations.event: 多次尝试not同技巧并寻求建议后仍not yet上鱼
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果用尽方法仍然not行，就说明我天生not行，而且以后也not会好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 降低外出频率、产生Withdrawal与Self-denial以避免再次失败

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain competence and recognition through hobbies, restoring positive feelings toward life and self
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评价为without能、被嘲笑或遭遇羞耻
defense_goal: 通过理性分析与技术细节控制not确定性，尽量避免暴露脆弱
Reduces revealing feelings to friends to avoid judgment and shame

object_relations.self_representation: 失败且被评判的业余爱好者
object_relations.object_representation: Picky others who may mock or devalue him (such as more capable fishing companions)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师邀请其回顾积极体验或挑战“我never能钓到鱼”的信念时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to interpret the counselor's exploration as downplaying his predicament, needing him to prove himself with evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds with technical, objectifying language (listing bait, methods, time periods, etc.), tone restrained, reduces emotional expression.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests she try sharing frustration more openly with friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为一旦分享就等于承认without能，朋友会觉得他小题大做或嘲笑他
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Postpones action on the grounds of 'what will they think of me', with a hesitant tone, emphasizing potential negative reactions to avoid trying.

manifestations: Favorite hobby loses its joy due to long returning empty-handed, feels life enjoyment has decreased
Under the value condition of 'only catching fish counts as success', the process experience is ignored
outcomes: Interest and pleasure in other life activities collaterally weakened

manifestations: 拥有钓友但not愿深入分享内心挫败，担心被评判
在重要关系情境中保持保留与Self-protection
outcomes: 支持资源not yet被有效利用，Increased subjective sense of isolation
负性情绪循环维持、问题持续

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Takes 'only catching fish counts as success' as an absolute standard to evaluate oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Assumes friends will think he is making a fuss or will laugh at him
因此回避更开放的表达与求助

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 自我贴标签“我not行/我失败”
在分享前过度担心他人评价，小心翼翼地Suppressing expression

positive_force: 对钓鱼有持续的热爱与投入意愿
Able to proactively try multiple strategies and ask others for advice
Has some social support (several fishing friends to talk with)
Willing to try open expression and reality testing (expressed willingness to try in counseling)
身体健康、No major physical illness
negative_force: 过度概括、negate积极、读心术与预测not yet来等认知偏差
以结果为唯一标准的僵化成败观
Self-doubt与羞耻，回避向他人求助或表达
Strong dependence on external validation; easily influenced by others' evaluations
After setbacks, motivation drops rapidly, forming a cycle of avoidance and reduced participation

target_behavior.behavior: 在钓鱼not yet上鱼后出现强烈Self-denial与挫败，进而减少外出或丧失兴趣
antecedent: 钓鱼行程结束时空手而归
在任何地点或时段钓鱼但not yet见上鱼
Being compared or noticed when talking with others about fishing results
target_behavior.core_reason: 以结果为中心的僵化信念（只有钓到鱼才算成功）与过度概括、预测not yet来等认知偏差导致自我价值与单次结果过度绑定
target_behavior.function: 短期逃避失败与羞耻感，试图通过Withdrawal维持自尊与控制感
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood、易怒与Decreased motivation，爱好乐趣减少并波及日常生活与社交

target_behavior.behavior: 回避向朋友表达真实困扰与情绪
antecedent: Thinking about or facing occasions of discussing fishing performance with fishing friends
被问及最近钓鱼感受与收获时
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被评价为“without能”与羞耻，将内在担忧Projection为他人会负面评价
target_behavior.function: Escapes potential negative evaluation and shame experiences, maintaining short-term psychological security
target_behavior.consequence: 支持资源not yet被激活，主观孤立与挫败感加重，问题循环被维持
